def factor_atr_volume_ratio(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    high = df_copy["high"]
    low = df_copy["low"]
    close = df_copy["close"]
    prev_close = close.shift(1)
    tr = pd.concat([high - low, (high - prev_close).abs(), (low - prev_close).abs()], axis=1).max(axis=1)
    atr = tr.rolling(14, min_periods=14).mean()
    norm_atr = atr / close.replace(0, np.nan)
    _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], 20, 1.5, 0.6)
    df_copy["factor_atr_volume_ratio"] = norm_atr * vol_ratio
    return df_copy["factor_atr_volume_ratio"]
description: Mutation of factor_atr_signedpower_volume. The parent amplified normalized ATR via signed power (squaring), which can over-weight extreme true range events and introduce instability. This mutation removes the signed power and multiplies the raw normalized ATR directly by the volume ratio, simplifying the signal to a smooth herding indicator. The core mechanism remains: elevated true range relative to price, combined with above-average volume, indicates crowding and directional consensus. The mutation aims to improve robustness and ICIR while preserving the direction and order of the parent signal.
